text: This report recommends a cost-of-living adjustment for Toronto Zoo staff in 2022.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Adopted the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 31, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 31, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo, remain confidential in its entirety as it pertains to information about labour relations/employee negotiations.
